:::{#exm-objective-function}
#### Residual sum of squares

For the polynomials $\modmem$ in @exm-model-family,
the [residual sum of squares](correlation-regression.qmd#def-rss) is an [objective function](#def-objective-function) $\objfn$:
it gives each polynomial the sum over the observations of its squared difference from the observed outcome.

:::
